name: Getty Villa
scope: Main museum villa, enclosing colonnades, tiled roofs and peristyle court; exclude modern campus parking and ancillary buildings.
era: surviving exterior represented by selected dated references

references.caption:
The Getty Villa — in Pacific Palisades, Los Angeles.
Fountain and sculpture in the Peristyle Garden of the Getty Villa Roman gardens.
Getty Villa Museum entrance from top of theater

review.method: Individually inspected outer-peristyle north facade/pool and west museum entrance originals; supplemental inner court, long-pool overview, colonnade closeup and local aerial. Inspected both pages of official 2023 Getty plan including axonometric and floor plans, plus current aerial roof context.
review.notes: Main villa and attached peristyles/terrace separated from modern campus buildings. Column orders, red tile roofs, ochre/red wall panels, long shaped pool, upper south balcony and open inner court recorded. Fine sculpture and murals remain outside exterior scope. Authoring acceptance only.
